nodes.label: Media Storage Backends
nodes.description: Three configurable storage backends for product images and store logos: local (development), S3 (production), and Cloudinary (production). Switched via MEDIA_STORAGE_BACKEND environment variable.

nodes.label: Local Storage Backend
nodes.description: Default backend for development and tests. Files stored in MEDIA_ROOT directory. Configured via MEDIA_STORAGE_BACKEND=local

nodes.label: S3 Storage Backend
nodes.description: Production storage backend using Amazon S3. Configured with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME, AWS_S3_REGION_NAME. Supports optional custom domain via AWS_S3_CUSTOM_DOMAIN for CDN.

nodes.label: Cloudinary Storage Backend
nodes.description: Production storage backend using Cloudinary. Configured with CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY, CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET, and optional CLOUDINARY_FOLDER prefix.

nodes.label: SERVE_MEDIA Configuration
nodes.description: Flag to enable serving media files in development via Gunicorn/Docker. Requires MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL for browser URLs. Stored in docker-infrastructure/.env

nodes.label: Docker Compose Setup
nodes.description: Full-stack Docker deployment with PostGIS (5432), Redis (6379), Mailpit (8025), and Gunicorn API. Orchestrated via docker-compose.yml at project root.

nodes.label: Make Commands - Root
nodes.description: Unified make commands for orchestrating all services: make up (all), make down, make docker-up (infrastructure only), make docker-down, make setup (full install), make backend-createsuperuser

nodes.label: Entrypoint Migration Flow
nodes.description: Automated setup on container start: wait for PostgreSQL, create PostGIS extension, run migrate --noinput, repair_migration_tables.py (for analytics/delivery), collectstatic, then start Gunicorn/Celery

nodes.label: ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF Configuration
nodes.description: Django security settings: ALLOWED_HOSTS must include server domain/IP, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS for form submissions. Set in docker-infrastructure/.env. Common issues: 400 Bad Request if host missing.

nodes.label: Railway Deployment Architecture
nodes.description: Railway-based deployment with 4 services: PostGIS database, Redis broker, Mailpit SMTP, and DTS-backend API. Uses railway.toml config file and environment variable references (${{postgis.DATABASE_URL}})

nodes.label: Railway Backend Configuration
nodes.description: DTS-backend service on Railway using Dockerfile (not Nixpacks). Root directory '/', references DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL from other services. Generate domain for public access.

nodes.label: Railway Environment Variables
nodes.description: Mandatory vars for Railway deployment: SECRET_KEY, DEBUG=False, ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, DATABASE_URL=${{postgis.DATABASE_URL}}, REDIS_URL=${{Redis.REDIS_URL}}, RUN_MIGRATIONS=true, LOG_LEVEL, GUNICORN_WORKERS, GUNICORN_TIMEOUT

nodes.label: Railway Internal Networking
nodes.description: Railway uses *.railway.internal hostnames for inter-service communication within the platform. DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL from other services use internal endpoints, not public TCP URLs.

nodes.label: Railway Media Storage Options
nodes.description: Two approaches: Option A - volume-based (staging): mount /app/backend/media volume, set SERVE_MEDIA=True. Option B - S3 (production): configure AWS_* vars, set MEDIA_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3

nodes.label: Railway Pre-deploy Commands
nodes.description: Entrypoint automatically handles migrations. Optional: configure Settings > Deploy > Pre-deploy command (redundant if RUN_MIGRATIONS=true). Creates PostGIS extension, runs migrate, repair_migration_tables.py, collectstatic

nodes.label: Railway Celery Workers and Beat
nodes.description: Two additional Railway services for async tasks: DTS-celery-worker (uses railway.worker.toml) and DTS-celery-beat (uses railway.beat.toml). No public domain, no HTTP healthcheck required.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI Matrix
nodes.description: 5 independent GitHub Actions workflows: DTS-E-Commerce monorepo root (all 4 projects), DTS-backend (PostGIS smoke), DTS-web-admin (lint + test + build), DTS-flutter-customer (analyze + ws smoke + flutter test), DTS-flutter-driver (analyze + ws/offers smoke + flutter test)

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Branch Triggers
nodes.description: CI runs on main, develop, and master (for submodule compatibility). Each repo has independent branch protection and merge workflows.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Unit Tests (No Secrets Required)
nodes.description: Current CI setup requires no GitHub Secrets or Variables for tests: tests mock FCM, use services (PostGIS/Redis), Channel layer in-memory. No Firebase/Railway/Google credentials needed.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions E2E (Optional)
nodes.description: E2E Playwright tests currently commented out. If enabled, requires GitHub Secrets: E2E_BASE_URL, E2E_MERCHANT_EMAIL, E2E_MERCHANT_PASSWORD. Needs stable deployed environment.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Activation Checklist
nodes.description: Per-repo setup: Settings > Actions > General > Allow all actions, Workflow permissions read/write. Each submodule needs .github/workflows/ci.yml committed and pushed to its own repo.

nodes.label: CI Smoke Tests - Realtime
nodes.description: Realtime-specific smoke tests in CI: backend signals (order push READY/searching_driver), notifications mapper/observability, chat ACL, WS origin validation, tracking destination, work zone radius. Flutter: WS URI env test, offers refresh. web-admin: order-chat-store unit test

nodes.label: Vertical Slice + Clean Architecture
nodes.description: Mandatory pattern per module: domain (no framework), application (use cases), infrastructure (ORM/API/UI). Dependencies point toward domain. Implemented in backend features/, Flutter features/, web-admin features/

nodes.label: Backend Feature Structure
nodes.description: Backend modules in features/<modulo>: domain/ (entities, value_objects, repositories abstract, services), application/ (use_cases, dto), infrastructure/ (models ORM, repositories impl, serializers DRF, views, signals, tasks, admin). Tests mirror this structure.

nodes.label: Django to Clean Architecture Mapping
nodes.description: domain = pure rules (no Django imports), application = use cases (calls domain + repos), infrastructure = persistence/HTTP/tasks (Models, DRF, Celery)

nodes.label: Flutter Feature Structure
nodes.description: Flutter modules in lib/features/<modulo>: domain/ (entities, repositories interfaces, usecases), application/ (Riverpod providers, state), infrastructure/ (datasources, models/DTOs, repository implementations), presentation/ (screens, widgets). Rule: presentation → application → domain ← infrastructure

nodes.label: ProductType Domain Model
nodes.description: Two product types: PHYSICAL (comida, artículos; stock-tracked), SERVICE (limpieza, reparaciones; requires_on_site_visit, no stock). Implemented in backend/features/products/domain/entities.py

nodes.label: Category Hierarchy (2 Levels)
nodes.description: Categories with optional parent_id (null = root, non-null = subcategory). Per-store hierarchy. Examples: Comida > Hamburguesas, Servicios del hogar > Limpieza

nodes.label: StockValidator Business Rule
nodes.description: Only validates stock for ProductType.PHYSICAL. Services never fail due to insufficient stock. Implemented in T1.4.2

nodes.label: Order States - Physical Products
nodes.description: Delivery flow: CREATED → ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT → IN_PREPARATION → READY_FOR_PICKUP → SEARCHING_DRIVER → DRIVER_ASSIGNED → PICKED_UP → ON_THE_WAY → DELIVERED

nodes.label: Order States - Services
nodes.description: Service order flow (no driver): CREATED → ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT → SCHEDULED → PROVIDER_EN_ROUTE → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED → PAID. Can be CANCELLED before IN_PROGRESS.

nodes.label: ServiceOrderDetails Model
nodes.description: Additional fields for service orders (T1.5.8): service_address (GeoLocation/text), scheduled_at (date/time), customer_notes (instructions), duration_minutes (copied from Product)

nodes.label: UV Package Manager
nodes.description: Python package manager for backend (not pip). Commands: uv add, uv sync, uv run python. Required for GDAL/PostGIS dependencies.

nodes.label: Docker PostGIS + Redis Requirement
nodes.description: Backend dev requires Docker for PostGIS (5432) and Redis (6379). Backend cannot run on host without GDAL. Run 'make docker-up' first.

nodes.label: Pytest Django DB Marker
nodes.description: Backend tests use @pytest.mark.django_db decorator for database access. Always run 'make backend-test' locally before pushing.

nodes.label: make setup
nodes.description: Complete setup command: installs all infrastructure (Docker), dependencies (uv for backend, npm for web-admin, Flutter), and creates initial configuration.

nodes.label: make docker-up
nodes.description: Start only infrastructure containers: PostGIS (5432) and Redis (6379). Needed before backend dev.

nodes.label: make up
nodes.description: Start full Docker stack: PostGIS, Redis, Mailpit, and API (Gunicorn + Celery). Resets containers on each run.

nodes.label: make backend-test
nodes.description: Run pytest for backend. Alternative: cd backend && uv run pytest -v

nodes.label: make backend-run
nodes.description: Run API locally on http://localhost:8000. Requires GDAL installed on host.

nodes.label: make web-admin-dev
nodes.description: Start Next.js dev server for web-admin at http://localhost:3000 with hot reload.

nodes.label: make flutter-test
nodes.description: Run flutter test for both flutter-customer and flutter-driver apps.

nodes.label: make test
nodes.description: Run all tests: backend pytest, web-admin unit, Flutter tests.

nodes.label: make web-admin-lint
nodes.description: Lint web-admin code (ESLint, Prettier).

nodes.label: make backend-createsuperuser
nodes.description: Create Django superuser interactively. Runs in Docker container.

nodes.label: make backend-shell
nodes.description: Enter Django interactive shell in Docker container.

nodes.label: make backend-check-db
nodes.description: List database tables and verify schema integrity. Useful for diagnosing migration issues.

nodes.label: make doctor
nodes.description: Diagnose common issues: ALLOWED_HOSTS, Django container health, HTTP 200 on API.

nodes.label: make backend-migrate-all
nodes.description: Run Django migrate in Docker container for all apps.

nodes.label: make restart-api
nodes.description: Rebuild and restart API container. Use after code or .env changes.

nodes.label: Task Workflow Process
nodes.description: Steps: 1. Read docs/PROGRESS.md for incomplete tasks, 2. Find task ID in docs/TASKS.md, 3. Read related docs (e.g., MERCHANT_ONBOARDING.md for Fase 6), 4. Implement with Vertical Slice + Clean Architecture, 5. Run specified tests, 6. Mark [x] in PROGRESS.md, 7. Commit with 'feat/fix(scope): description'

nodes.label: ScopedPermission Pattern
nodes.description: Backend authorization via ScopedPermission + user_role field in CustomUser. DRF serializers check permissions in infrastructure/

nodes.label: Web-admin Component Patterns
nodes.description: Server Components by default, 'use client' only for interactivity. Zustand stores per feature in features/*/stores/. Consume /api/v1/ exclusively (no BFF paths).

nodes.label: Flutter Riverpod Testing
nodes.description: Use case tests mock repositories with mocktail. Widget tests use testWidgets + pumpWidget.

nodes.label: Fase 6 - Merchant Onboarding Priority
nodes.description: Current development priority: Merchant onboarding + seller portal (T6.x tasks). Fase 1-3 (backend + web MVP) complete. Fase 4-5 (Flutter + realtime) pending.

nodes.label: Submodule Git Workflow
nodes.description: Each project is separate Git repo with own CI/branch rules. Commit changes in submodule folder, then commit root .gitmodules pointer. Don't force-push submodule branches without coordination.

nodes.label: Debugging: API Not Responding
nodes.description: Run 'make doctor' - checks ALLOWED_HOSTS, Django container, and HTTP 200

nodes.label: Debugging: Photos Not Visible
nodes.description: Run 'make media-check' - inspects SERVE_MEDIA, MEDIA_ROOT, and files on disk

nodes.label: Debugging: Migrations Stuck
nodes.description: 'make backend-check-db' to list tables; 'make backend-makemigrations-all' if schema drift

nodes.label: Debugging: Container Crash
nodes.description: 'make logs' (all) or 'docker logs dts-api' (single container)

nodes.label: Debugging: Stale Container State
nodes.description: 'make restart-api' rebuilds API + workers

nodes.label: Docker Server Requirements
nodes.description: Minimum Docker 24+, Docker Compose v2+, Git, open ports 8000 (API), optional 8025 (Mailpit). Python, GDAL, PostgreSQL, Redis not installed on host - all in Docker.

nodes.label: Docker Server Installation Steps
nodes.description: Three steps: 1. Clone + configure docker-infrastructure/.env (SECRET_KEY, ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, DEBUG=False), 2. 'make up' (builds image, creates services, runs migrations, collectstatic), 3. 'make backend-createsuperuser'

nodes.label: Docker Server Service URLs
nodes.description: API: http://SERVIDOR:8000, Swagger: http://SERVIDOR:8000/api/v1/docs/, Django Admin: http://SERVIDOR:8000/admin/, Mailpit: http://SERVIDOR:8025

nodes.label: Docker: Firewall and DNS Setup
nodes.description: Ubuntu/Debian firewall: 'sudo ufw allow 8000/tcp 8025/tcp'. DNS local: edit /etc/hosts to map IP to extreme.local

nodes.label: Docker Daily Commands
nodes.description: 'make up' (start/update), 'make down' (stop), 'make logs' (view errors), 'make ps' (status), 'make restart-api' (after .env change)

nodes.label: Docker: Git Pull Update
nodes.description: 'git pull' then 'make up' - no manual migration needed, entrypoint handles it automatically

nodes.label: Django Admin Interface
nodes.description: All project models registered in /admin/: users, profiles, FCM tokens, stores, products, orders, tracking GPS, analytics. Geographic fields shown as text coordinates (no OpenLayers in Docker).

nodes.label: Docker: Production Security Checklist
nodes.description: Checklist: unique SECRET_KEY, DEBUG=False, real ALLOWED_HOSTS, strong DB_PASSWORD, HTTPS reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy), backup dts_postgis_data volume, FCM JSON in docker-infrastructure/volumes/fcm/

nodes.label: Railway: CLI Superuser Creation
nodes.description: Using Railway CLI from local Mac: npm i -g @railway/cli, railway login, railway link, railway service DTS-backend, railway run uv run python manage.py createsuperuser

nodes.label: Railway: Health Check
nodes.description: Verify deployment: curl -sS https://TU-DOMINIO.up.railway.app/api/v1/docs/ -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' or view Swagger in browser. Check logs: railway logs --service DTS-backend

nodes.label: Railway: Local Dev with Remote DB
nodes.description: Develop locally pointing to Railway PostGIS: Use public TCP URL (not *.railway.internal) in docker-infrastructure/.env for DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL. Run 'make up' locally with remote DB.

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure Definition
nodes.description: Root repo orchestrates 4 submodules: backend/ (Django API), web-admin/ (Next.js), flutter-customer/, flutter-driver/. Root contains Makefile, docker-compose.yml, scripts/, docs/

nodes.label: Monorepo Clone with Submodules
nodes.description: Clone: git clone --recurse-submodules. If already cloned: git submodule update --init --recursive

nodes.label: Backend Stack Definition
nodes.description: Django + DRF + Celery + Channels + PostGIS. API only, no templates. Uses uv package manager.

nodes.label: Web-admin Stack Definition
nodes.description: Next.js + React + Tailwind. Merchant and super admin portals.

nodes.label: Flutter Apps Stack Definition
nodes.description: Flutter + Riverpod. Two apps: flutter-customer (client), flutter-driver (delivery driver). Clean Architecture per module.

nodes.label: Cursor AI Shortcuts
nodes.description: Cursor commands: /fase-1, /fase-3, /tarea T1.2.3, /progreso. Defined in .cursor/rules/ and .cursor/commands/
